headline: BROCK drops 21.88% on 5.4x volume with no matching filing; PF debentureholders' meeting (RM G) and CPNREIT subleasing announcement (RM C) also require attention
market_take: Coverage shows broad weakness led by PROP and CONS, with 4 names down 10% or more intraday. Unusual-trading alerts were concentrated in FOOD/PROP/PF&REIT, but only CPNREIT, MADAME (via XBIO linkage), and NL have a corresponding disclosure to anchor the move. Several large intraday reversals (PRECHA +10% gap then -15.15% intraday, CGD -10% intraday, EVER +16.67%) suggest volatile single-name trading ahead of catalysts.
